tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.deleteConfirmDescription: This will remove all data for {{id}} in this database (encoded clips, channels and ad detection). insight-api is not affected. This cannot be undone.
tenants.adRecognitionEnabledLabel: Enable AD recognition for live channels
tenants.adRecognitionEnabledHint: When enabled, this tenant's live channels are periodically analyzed to detect advertising windows.
tenants.subtitlesEnabledLabel: Enable subtitling (clip subtitles + realtime transcribe UI)
tenants.subtitlesDefaultEnabledLabel: Enable subtitles by default for new clips
tenants.availableLanguagesHint: Pool of languages offered in the editor for VTT generation and news tabs. At least one is required.
tenants.newsButtonEnabledLabel: Show transcript & news button in the editor
tenants.newsButtonEnabledHint: When on, each clip row shows the transcript control (before and after encode). Requires subtitling enabled.
tenants.newsDefaultGenerateLabel: Generate news drafts by default for new clips
tenants.newsDefaultGenerateHint: Pre-checks all tenant languages in the transcript modal news toggles for new clips.
tenants.subtitlesDefaultBurnInLabel: Burn subtitles into video by default
tenants.subtitlesDefaultBurnInLanguageHint: Language embedded into new clips when burn-in default is on. Only tenant languages from the Languages tab are listed.
tenants.subtitlesDefaultInferSpeakerNamesLabel: Name speakers in subtitles by default
tenants.subtitlesDefaultNewsEnLabel: Generate English news draft by default
tenants.subtitlesDefaultNewsEsLabel: Generate Spanish news draft by default
tenants.subtitlesDefaultNewsHeLabel: Generate Hebrew news draft by default
tenants.syndicationYoutubeEnabledLabel: Enable YouTube syndication (per-clip Syndication UI in the editor)
tenants.syndicationYoutubeDefaultEnabledLabel: Enable YouTube syndication by default for new clips
tenants.syndicationTwitterEnabledLabel: Enable X / Twitter syndication (per-clip Syndication UI in the editor)
tenants.syndicationTwitterDefaultEnabledLabel: Enable X / Twitter syndication by default for new clips
tenants.syndicationFacebookEnabledLabel: Enable Facebook syndication (per-clip Syndication UI in the editor)
tenants.syndicationFacebookDefaultEnabledLabel: Enable Facebook syndication by default for new clips
tenants.syndicationInstagramEnabledLabel: Enable Instagram syndication (per-clip Syndication UI in the editor)
tenants.syndicationInstagramDefaultEnabledLabel: Enable Instagram syndication by default for new clips
tenants.syndicationTiktokEnabledLabel: Enable TikTok syndication (per-clip Syndication UI in the editor)
tenants.syndicationTiktokDefaultEnabledLabel: Enable TikTok syndication by default for new clips
tenants.metadataHint: Optional. Shallow-merged on editor visits. Leave empty to clear.
tenants.metadataInvalid: Metadata must be valid JSON object.
tenants.youtubeConnectionHint: Links to the YouTube account authorized via OAuth. Disconnecting clears the saved refresh token; this tenant will need to authorize again to publish.
tenants.youtubeDisconnectConfirmDescription: The refresh token stored for this tenant will be removed. YouTube publishing will be disabled until it is authorized again.
tenants.twitterConnectionHint: OAuth refresh token for this tenant. Disconnect clears the token; the tenant must authorize again to publish to X.
tenants.twitterDisconnectConfirmDescription: The refresh token stored for this tenant will be removed. X publishing will be disabled until it is authorized again.
tenants.facebookConnectionHint: Meta user token and selected Page for this tenant. Disconnect clears tokens and the Page selection.
tenants.facebookDisconnectConfirmDescription: Stored tokens and the selected Page will be removed. The tenant must authorize again and pick a Page to publish.
tenants.facebookPageSelectHint: Load pages from the authorized Meta user and choose which one this tenant should publish to.
tenants.instagramConnectionHint: Meta user token and selected Instagram Business account. Disconnect clears tokens and the account selection.
tenants.instagramDisconnectConfirmDescription: Stored tokens and the selected account will be removed. The tenant must authorize again and pick an account to publish.
tenants.tiktokConnectionHint: OAuth refresh token for this tenant's TikTok account. Disconnect clears the token; the tenant must authorize again to publish.
tenants.tiktokDisconnectConfirmDescription: The stored refresh token will be removed. TikTok publishing will be disabled until it is authorized again.
tenants.syndicationAccountsHint: Each row is an OAuth-connected account for this tenant. Disconnect removes only that account; use the network tabs to disconnect all accounts on a platform.
tenants.syndicationAccountDisconnectConfirmDescr: Remove {{name}} ({{platform}}) from this tenant. Other accounts on the same platform will stay connected.
tenants.networkAccountsHint: {{count}} of {{max}} accounts connected for this network.
tenants.syndicationMaxAccountsHint: Maximum OAuth accounts this tenant may connect on this network (default {{defaultMax}}). Save to apply.

streams.streamsEmpty: No archive-enabled streams found for this tenant.
streams.scansEmpty: No scans recorded yet for this stream.

clips.title: Generated clips
clips.noVideo: No HTTP(S) output URL available for playback.

settings.title: Settings
settings.syndicationIntro: Configure Immergo defaults for publishing to social platforms. Per-clip options are set in the editor.
settings.oauthNotConfiguredYoutube: Missing YouTube OAuth client ID, client secret, and redirect URI (fill below or set YOUTUBE_* on the backend).
settings.oauthNotConfiguredTwitter: Missing X OAuth client ID, client secret, and redirect URI (fill below or set TWITTER_* on the backend).
settings.oauthNotConfiguredFacebook: Missing Facebook App ID, app secret, and redirect URI (fill below or set FACEBOOK_* on the backend).
settings.oauthNotConfiguredInstagram: Missing Instagram App ID, app secret, and redirect URI (fill below or set INSTAGRAM_* on the backend).
settings.oauthEnvWhereHint: Store OAuth client ID, secret, and redirect URI in the accordions below (persisted in the database). If a field is empty in the database, the Node process environment is used (e.g. backend/.env). Client secrets are never returned by the API: leave blank to keep the stored value.
settings.oauthYoutubeBlockIntro: Google OAuth app credentials (stored in the database). Default publishing options are below.
settings.ytOauthClientSecretExtra: Optional when editing: only fill this to save or replace the secret in the database. Empty = keep the current stored secret.
settings.ytOauthClientSecretSavedDb: A client secret is already stored in the database. Leave the field empty to keep it.
settings.ytDefaultPrivacy: Default privacy for new clip syndication
settings.oauthTwitterBlockIntro: X OAuth 2.0 app credentials (stored in the database). Default tweet text is optional.
settings.twOauthClientSecretExtra: Optional when editing: only fill to save or replace the secret in the database. Empty = keep the current stored secret.
settings.twOauthClientSecretSavedDb: A client secret is already stored in the database. Leave the field empty to keep it.
settings.oauthFacebookBlockIntro: Meta app credentials (stored in the database). Default video description is optional.
settings.fbOauthClientSecretExtra: Optional when editing: only fill to save or replace the secret in the database. Empty = keep the current stored secret.
settings.fbOauthClientSecretSavedDb: An app secret is already stored in the database. Leave the field empty to keep it.
settings.oauthInstagramBlockIntro: Meta app credentials for Instagram Content Publishing (stored in the database). Can match the Facebook app. Default caption is optional.
settings.igOauthClientSecretExtra: Optional when editing: only fill to save or replace the secret in the database. Empty = keep the current stored secret.
settings.igOauthClientSecretSavedDb: An app secret is already stored in the database. Leave the field empty to keep it.
settings.oauthNotConfiguredTiktok: Missing TikTok Client key, client secret, and redirect URI (fill below or set TIKTOK_* on the backend).
settings.oauthTiktokBlockIntro: TikTok Login Kit + Content Posting API credentials (stored in the database). Default caption and privacy apply when the clip has no override.
settings.ttOauthClientSecretExtra: Optional when editing: only fill to save or replace the secret in the database. Empty = keep the current stored secret.
settings.ttOauthClientSecretSavedDb: A client secret is already stored in the database. Leave the field empty to keep it.
settings.ttDefaultPrivacyLevel: Default privacy for new clip syndication
settings.ttDomainVerificationPath: Public path for TikTok domain verification file
settings.ttDomainVerificationFileName: Verification file name (for URL prefix mode)
settings.ttDomainVerificationUploadFailed: Could not read the selected file.
settings.validationFailed: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
